name: restaurant-location-production-readiness
title: Harden restaurant current-location capture for production
description: Use the same browser-side reverse-geocoding path as Home across restaurant setup and customer addresses, with a backend fallback, then persist the resolved address and coordinates.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Manual Network inspection showed browser GPS succeeds but the backend reverse-geocode proxy returns Nominatim access errors. Home already succeeds by calling Nominatim directly from the browser. The fix will reuse that path in a shared helper and keep the backend endpoint only as a fallback.
